article_title: Super flu vaccine ready as NHS regroups from busiest summer ever

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Why flu vaccines have been withdrawn from pharmacies
The rollout of an updated flu vaccine and who can receive it at different times
A plan to replace flu vaccination with RSV vaccination
Evidence that this winter's flu season will definitely be severe
tasks.correct_answer: The rollout of an updated flu vaccine and who can receive it at different times
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה שהחיסון עודכן מול זן Super-K, מי מקבל אותו תחילה ומתי קבוצות נוספות זכאיות לו.

tasks.prompt: Why are schoolchildren among the first groups offered the vaccine?
options: They are the only people who can catch Super-K
They need two injections before winter
They can catch and spread flu easily, so vaccinating them also protects others
They are not allowed to receive the nasal spray
tasks.correct_answer: They can catch and spread flu easily, so vaccinating them also protects others
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ילדים נדבקים ומפיצים שפעת בקלות, והגנתם מסייעת גם לתינוקות, לאחים ולסבים ולסבתות.

tasks.prompt: When can most eligible people aged 65 and over receive a free NHS flu vaccine?
options: Only after flu cases peak
From July
From September with schoolchildren
From October
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בני 65 ומעלה נמנים עם הקבוצות הזכאיות לחיסון חינם החל מאוקטובר.

tasks.prompt: Why do UK experts examine flu seasons in Australia and New Zealand?
options: Their earlier seasonal peak may offer clues about what could happen in the UK
Those countries manufacture every NHS vaccine
Their populations cannot catch Super-K
The UK uses exactly the same vaccination timetable
tasks.correct_answer: Their earlier seasonal peak may offer clues about what could happen in the UK
tasks.explanation_hebrew: עונת השפעת בחצי הכדור הדרומי מגיעה לשיאה ביולי או באוגוסט, ולכן היא עשויה לספק רמזים לעונה העתידית בבריטניה.

tasks.prompt: What does “mutate” mean when the article says influenza viruses constantly mutate?
options: Disappear completely after one season
Change genetically over time
Become impossible to treat
Spread only among children
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר של נגיפים, mutate פירושו להשתנות מבחינה גנטית לאורך זמן.

tasks.prompt: What does the expression “knock you for six” mean in Dr Doyle's warning?
options: Make you immune for six years
Require exactly six vaccine doses
Make you feel very ill or badly affected
Cause illness only at the age of six
tasks.correct_answer: Make you feel very ill or badly affected
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי הבריטי knock you for six מתאר פגיעה חזקה מאוד או מחלה שמותירה אדם במצב קשה.

tasks.prompt: Explain why this year's flu vaccine was changed and how the rollout is being staged.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את הסיבה לעדכון ולפחות שלושה פרטים מדויקים על לוח הזמנים או קבוצות הזכאות.
expected_points: A mutated strain called subclade K or Super-K circulated last winter
Last winter's flu season began more than a month early
Flu vaccines are updated annually to match circulating strains
This year's vaccine was tweaked to better match subclade K
Schoolchildren and pregnant women can receive it from September
Other eligible groups, including most people aged 65 and over, can receive it from October
Children aged two and over generally receive a nasal spray
Adults receive an injection
One dose is needed ahead of winter

tasks.prompt: Why does the article caution readers not to misunderstand the term “Super flu”?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר מה המונח אינו אומר ומה כן מסביר את השימוש בו.
expected_points: Super flu is not a medical term
It does not mean the virus is harder to treat
The name relates to limited existing immunity to the strain
The strain is a mutated seasonal influenza called subclade K
The article avoids presenting the name as proof that this season will be severe

tasks.prompt: Summarise the reasons for the updated vaccine, the early priorities and the uncertainty about the coming flu season.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לחבר בין אירועי החורף הקודם, עדכון החיסון, סדר הזכאות והמידע שעדיין אינו ידוע.
expected_points: Super-K circulated during an unusually early flu season last winter
The updated vaccine better matches subclade K
Schoolchildren and pregnant women are offered vaccination first
Vaccinating children can protect vulnerable relatives as well
Most other eligible groups begin in October
The NHS is preparing early after its busiest summer
It is unclear when flu will arrive or how severe the season will be
Australia and New Zealand have so far experienced a relatively mild season
Experts still recommend caution and uptake among eligible people

tasks.prompt: Write a clear public-information notice explaining who should seek a flu vaccine, when, and why.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית בצורה ברורה ומדויקת, לכלול את מועדי ספטמבר ואוקטובר, לפחות שלוש קבוצות זכאות והסבר קצר כיצד החיסון פועל.
expected_points: Schoolchildren and pregnant women can receive a free NHS vaccine from September
Most people aged 65 and over can receive one from October
Include other eligible groups such as people with certain long-term conditions or care-home residents
Mention carers or people living with someone with a weakened immune system
Children generally receive a nasal spray and adults an injection
A single dose offers protection ahead of winter
The vaccine cannot give a person flu
It helps the body learn how to fight the virus
